build_EncoderDecoderMask2Former: build a Mask2Former encoder-decoder segmentor with backbone, decode head, and optional neck for semantic segmentation
run_forward_train: run the training forward pass to extract features and compute decode and auxiliary head losses
test_slide_inference: test sliding window inference with configurable crop size and stride for large image segmentation
run_simple_test: run simple inference on a single image and return predicted segmentation class maps
run_aug_test: run test-time augmented inference by averaging predictions across multiple augmented image variants
